title: 97 East Summersweet Lane Vacation Rental
meta_description: 97 East Summersweet Lane is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Indulge in relaxed luxury at 97 East Summersweet Lane, a beautifully designed WaterColor retreat ideal for family getaways or a friends’ coastal escape. Nestled in the sought-after Crossings District, this home offers elegant interiors, thoughtful amenities, and effortless access to the community’s best experiences.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 8 Passes Included Parking for 2 Cars 6-Passenger Electric Cart 4 Adult Bikes Included Second Living Space With TV TV in Every Bedroom Screened Porch With Outdoor Seating Exterior Shower Natural Gas Grill Short Bike Ride to the Dragonfly Pool 5-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to the WaterColor Beach Club Experience the Home Step inside to a spacious open-concept living area, perfect for gathering and unwinding after a day in the sun. The living room features a flat-screen TV and comfortable seating, while the adjoining dining area seats ten for family meals or relaxed dinners with friends. The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and generous counter space for easy meal preparation. The first-floor primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a king bed, private bathroom, and walk-in shower. A convenient half bath and laundry area are also located on this level. Upstairs, a second primary suite includes a king bed, walk-in shower, and private access to a covered balcony. Another king bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom, and the fourth bedroom is perfect for kids, features a twin-over-twin bunk setup and TV, sharing a full bath with a shower/tub combination. The upstairs living area provides additional space to relax or enjoy a family movie night. Outside, guests can unwind on the screened porch, enjoy the convenience of an exterior shower, or cook dinner on the natural gas grill. With its prime Crossings location, 97 East Summersweet Lane offers easy access to Dragonfly Pool and Park, a quick bike ride to Camp WaterColor, and a short electric cart ride to Seaside or the Beach Club.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Life in WaterColor Guests of 97 East Summersweet Lane enjoy the best of WaterColor living, whether biking through scenic paths, relaxing poolside, or exploring nearby Seaside’s shops and dining. With exclusive Beach Club access, thoughtfully designed interiors, and easy proximity to WaterColor’s attractions, this home offers a perfectly balanced coastal experience.
